iležüġüi: ile- — to send; past ending -žüġüi, 'sent' (verb, past, front-vowel form; uncertain) [去了] · also 'went' (ile- as 'to go', uncertain; compare ileġed)
üge-ji: üge — word, speech; accusative -ji, 'the word (object)' (noun + case) [言語 行]

ükürün: ükü- — to die; converb of time -rün (after a vowel stem), 'when dying' (verb, converb of time) [死時]

teṅgeri: teṅgeri — Heaven, the sky god (noun) [天] · also a man's name, Tenggeri (Ming 人名) [人名]

kürčü: kür- — to reach, arrive; converb -čü after r, 'arriving' (verb, converb) [到着]
qadquldužu: qadqul- — to fight, clash (Ming 厮殺); -du- 'together, mutually' + converb -žu, 'fighting each other' (verb, converb) [厮殺︀着]

keistele: keis- — to scrape (stem inferred; Ming 刮); -tele, 'as if, like' (verb + ending; compare the published keisgen and hünesü-ġer keisgen 'scraped off'; the ending is uncertain, Ming 般) [刮般]
talaγ̇ulba: tala- — to plunder, take captive (verb; stem inferred from the Ming); causative -γ̇ul-, past -ba, 'took captive' (verb, causative past) [虜︀了]
erekün: erekün — daring, bold (adjective; the Ming 敢望 'dare to expect'; the ending is uncertain) [敢望] · here read as ere 'man' + noun ending -kün, 'brave one' (Ming 勇)
omoγun: omoγun — quarrelsome, ready to fight others (adjective; Ming 與人相鬭; stem uncertain) [與人相鬭]

eimün: eimün — such, of this kind (Ming 這般每) (adjective or pronoun) [這般每]
teimün: teimün — such, of that kind (adjective; Ming 那般; related to tein 'thus') [那般]
čeriġüd: čerig — soldier; plural -d, 'soldiers' (noun + plural; the vowel is Shiratori's linking -ü-) [軍每]
küġün-e: küġün — person, man (not köġün 'son'); dative -e, 'to a man, to someone' (noun + case; Ming 人行) [人行]

žarliγ: žarliγ — command, decree (Ming 聖旨) (noun) [聖旨]

žusažu: žun — summer; verb-maker -sa-, 'spend (the summer)'; converb -žu, '-ing' (noun-verb, converb) [住夏着]
ülidtele: ülid- — to destroy utterly (stem inferred; Ming 盡絕; compare ülidgebe); -tele, 'until, down to' (verb + limit suffix) [盡絕]
tendēče: tende — there; ablative -ēče, 'from there' (adverb + case; long vowel from tende + -eče) [那裏自]
boγ̇orču: Boγorču — Bo'orchu, a man's name (personal name; Ming 人名) [人名]
muqali: Muqali — a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
qojar-a: qojar — two, the pair; dative -a, 'by the two' (numeral + case; here the agent after a passive) [兩箇 行] · also 'to the two' (Ming 兩箇行), the addressees of an order, in aqa qojar-a ügüle
sojurγarun: sojurγa- — to show favour, bestow grace; converb of time -run, 'when showing favour' (verb, converb of time) [恩賜時]
küčün-e: küčü — strength, power (stem küčün- before a case ending); dative-locative -n-e, 'with strength, to one's strength' (noun + dative-locative, front-vowel form) [氣力行]
abtuγai: ab- — to take, receive; optative -tuγai, 'let him receive' (verb, optative, third person) [受者︀]
bolurun: bol- — to become (verb); -urun, converb of time, 'when becoming' (verb, converb; Ming 做的) [做的]
sojurγal: sojurγal — favour, grace, bounty (noun; from sojurγa- 'to show favour') [恩賜]
ögürün: ög- — to give; converb of time -ürün, 'when giving' (verb, converb of time; Ming 呵) [與呵] · also with the Ming 時 'when', not 呵 [與時]

irgen-eče: irgen — people; ablative -eče, 'from' (noun + case, front-vowel form; the Ming 處) [百姓 處]

sačaγ̇u: sačaγ̇u — alike, equally (adverb; the Ming 一般 'the same') [一般]

daγaγ̇ulžu: daγa- — to follow; causative -γ̇ul-, converb -žu, 'making follow, having them follow' (verb, causative converb) [隨着]

qormai: qormai — skirt, hem; of a mountain, its foot (noun; Ming 裙 'skirt') [裙]

ažuγ̇ui-že: a- — to be; past -žuγ̇ui, 'was'; particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle; Ming 有來 也者) [有來 也者︀]

bijü-že: bü- — to be; present bijü, 'there is' + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb + particle) [有 也者︀]
